fields.default: The six questions we hear on almost every first call.

default.question: How long does it take to set up Fieldnote?
default.answer: Most teams record their first interview the same day. Connect your calendar and video tool, invite your team, and Fieldnote joins the next call you schedule.

default.question: Which languages can you transcribe?
default.answer: Thirty-two, including French, German, Spanish, Portuguese and Japanese. Highlights translate into English in one click.

default.question: Where do you store our recordings?
default.answer: In the region you pick when you sign up: Canada, the EU or the US. Everything is encrypted at rest and in transit.

default.question: Do you charge for every seat?
default.answer: Only for people who run interviews. Teammates who watch highlights and leave comments are free on every plan.

default.question: How does the free trial work?
default.answer: You get every feature for 14 days and up to ten interviews. No credit card, and nothing is deleted when the trial ends.

default.question: Can we import interviews we already recorded?
default.answer: Yes. Drop in files or connect your cloud drive, and past interviews are transcribed and tagged like new ones.
